scope: Deterministic Chromium protocol fixtures with manually advanced RAF, instrumented model and controlled native phone snapshots. Not gameplay, performance or physical hardware evidence.

tests.name: Default games retain one-frame Enter A behavior
Opt-in DOM Enter stays held and releases as A
Opt-in native Enter down/up preserves held A
Coalesced opt-in Enter tap survives zero-physics frames exactly once
Holding the menu confirm and DOM repeat cannot create a game A
Pause cancels held keyboard A; repeat cannot rearm before keyup
Remote A/B held across pause stay quarantined until raw release
Connected phone cancelSeq distinguishes cancellation from ordinary release
CancelSeq change with a still-held remote button cannot restore that hold
First phone connection establishes a cancelSeq baseline without cancelling local input
CancelSeq wrap/reset is detected rather than ignored as a lower value
Phone disconnect freezes the model and permits independent keyboard takeover
Fresh phone hold sampled in the resume frame cannot bypass clearInput
Cancellation survives zero-step RAF frames and reaches all substeps of its owned sample
Retry clears held keyboard input and ignores its later DOM repeats
